answer: A bond of 15% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in voyage, and ocean reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 92 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ridge account. A farm of 1744 identities would post 951 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
